macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks rally as technology shares rebound
items.summary: The Dow rose 0.5% to 52,486.49, the S&P 500 gained 1.3% to 7,619.38, and the Nasdaq Composite advanced 1.6% to 25,466.19. Technology and semiconductor stocks led the gains, while Apple closed at a record high.

items.title: CoreWeave outlook eases concerns about AI spending
items.summary: CoreWeave shares surged about 20% after an encouraging earnings outlook, helping lift Nvidia and other semiconductor stocks. The rebound reassured investors that demand for AI infrastructure remains strong despite recent concerns about elevated valuations.

items.title: Hot inflation strengthens expectations for another Fed hike
items.summary: Higher-than-expected October inflation has increased market expectations for an additional Federal Reserve rate increase, potentially as soon as December. Goldman Sachs reportedly pushed its forecast for the next rate cut to December 2027 and expects another 25-basis-point hike in March.

items.title: Dollar reaches 19-month high as rate-hike bets grow
items.summary: The U.S. dollar climbed to its highest level since April 2025 as hotter inflation and hawkish monetary-policy expectations supported the currency. The dollar’s advance has increased pressure on other major currencies, with dollar-yen approaching 160.

items.title: Global equities remain resilient despite bond-market stress
items.summary: Global stocks stayed near record highs even as government-bond yields rose, oil prices increased, and investors questioned the sustainability of the AI rally. The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield reportedly moved above 5%, while Japanese and European borrowing costs also reached elevated levels.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum trade near flat
items.summary: Bitcoin was reported at approximately $74,015, up 0.3% over 24 hours, while Ethereum was around $2,056, up 0.2%. Another market report put Bitcoin below $74,000 and Ethereum down 0.8%, indicating modestly mixed readings across market trackers.

items.title: Miami-Dade supports Bitcoin property-tax payments
items.summary: Miami-Dade County announced that property owners can optionally pay taxes online or at county tax service points using Bitcoin through supported exchanges or digital wallets. Traditional payment methods remain available.

items.title: Across Protocol investigates potential security incident
items.summary: Cross-chain bridge Across Protocol warned users to avoid its application, wallet connections, transaction signatures, and authorizations while it investigates a possible security incident.

items.title: Morgan Stanley transfers SOL to Coinbase Prime
items.summary: On-chain monitors reported that Morgan Stanley moved 48,828 SOL, valued at roughly $4.01 million, from an MSOL Solana ETF wallet to Coinbase Prime.

items.title: Strategy faces potential MSCI index removal
items.summary: Strategy, the largest corporate holder of Bitcoin, was reported to be slated for removal from MSCI indexes, a development that could affect institutional index-linked exposure to the company.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI reportedly surpasses $1 billion in pre-orders
items.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI has reportedly exceeded $1 billion in gross pre-order revenue ahead of its November 19 launch, with more than 10 million digital pre-orders claimed by the report.

items.title: Tomb Raider: Catalyst delayed to 2028 and confirmed for Switch 2
items.summary: Amazon Games reportedly moved the next mainline Tomb Raider game, Tomb Raider: Catalyst, to 2028 and confirmed a Nintendo Switch 2 version.

items.title: Sonic Pico Park launches on Switch 2, Switch and PC
items.summary: Sonic Pico Park is reportedly now available across Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch and PC for $9.99.

items.title: Kojima Productions showcases Physint and OD: Knock developments
items.summary: A Tokyo exhibition offered new information about Kojima Productions projects, including Physint and OD: Knock, which is being developed in partnership with Xbox.

items.title: Phantom Blade Zero wins October PlayStation Players’ Choice
items.summary: S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero was selected by PlayStation players as the platform’s best new game for October 2026.

items.title: Fortnite servers undergo maintenance for Update 43.10
items.summary: Epic Games temporarily took Fortnite offline to deploy Update 43.10, affecting login, matchmaking and item-shop access during maintenance.
